generate_tokens_autoregressive: generate token IDs autoregressively using a LlamaForCausalLM model with KV cache for fast generation
generate_tokens_with_early_exit: generate tokens using an early exit layer to skip full model forward passes for faster inference
generate_tokens_with_logits_processors: generate tokens with custom logits processors applied before decoding the next token
generate_tokens_with_streaming: generate tokens and stream each token through a TextStreamer as it is produced
generate_tokens_with_stopping_criteria: generate tokens until a custom stopping criteria is met or EOS token is encountered
